The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c417858c9fe566da), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 9-10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: There is a constant CE, depending only on E, with the following property. Fix an odd fundamental discriminant h0, prime to 2N, with c2(E(h0)) = 0. Suppose that for arbitrarily large b there is a family hx = h0 Y q∈Q (q∗ )λq(x) , x ∈ Fb 2, λq ∈ (Fb 2)∗ , (3.2) 9 where Q consists of distinct primes outside 2Nh0, q∗ = (−1/q)q, and every hx has the same sign and the same local squareclasses at 2N. Assume that a constant B, independent of b, satisfies L(E(hx) , 1) ̸= 0, D(hx) ≤ B (x ̸= 0). (3.3) If E[2] is irreducible, assume also that some L, independent of b, satisfies v2(q2 − 1) ≤ L (q ∈ Q). (3.4) Then L(E(h0), 1) ̸= 0 and D(h0) ≤ B + CE. (3.5) The necessary dimension may depend on h0, its finite Selmer group, and the bound in Equation (3.4); CE does not.
